tools.description: Write bytes to a file on disk. The path must be an absolute path. Provide exactly one of body or body_b64.

body.description: UTF-8 text contents. Exactly one of body or body_b64 is required.

body_b64.description: Base64-encoded contents. Rejected if body is also set.

count.description: The number of items to return in a single page of results, which the server Values above 100 are not allowed and negative numbers are invalid.

limit.description: Sets the limit. Anything over 100 errors.

path.description: Target path, e.g. /srv/data/out.txt. It must be absolute, not relative.

tools.name: write_file

ISO8601Duration.description: An ISO 8601 duration. Must match the P#DT#H#M#S grammar.

default.description: A definition whose name collides with a metadata key. It must not be dropped.

start.description: Event start time. The format must be RFC3339, e.g. 2026-08-08T14:00:00Z. Values without a timezone are rejected.
